title: Nana mai aagayi hoon ghar baar sab lutaake
body:
NANA MAI AGAYI HU GHAR BAR SAB LUTAKE...
Nana mai agayi hu ghar bar sab lutake, Zehra ke gulista'n se Karbobala saja ke.
Nana tumhari Zainab ab woh nahi rahi hai, Pehchan na sakoge halat badal gayi hai, Mousam guzare maine har gaam bas jafa ke.
Hum seh rahe the Nana jo jo bhi gham huwe the, Shayed bata na paau jitne sitam huwe the, Lekin tumhari ummat khush thi hame satake.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kadiyal jawa'n ke dil pe zalim ne mara naiza, Bhai ne kis tarah se seene se woh nikala, Qaime se lasha lane Sheh kis tarah uthake.
Qasim ke haye tan ko pamaal kardiya tha, Ghatri me Shaah laye ye haal kardiya tha, Tukde huwe badan ke Farwa ke dilruba ke.
Nana mere pisar bhi maqtal me khogaye hai, Abbas ibne Haider dariya pe sogaye hai, Raahe Khuda me baazu dono waha'n katake.
Besheer tashnalab tha teere sitam se chuta, Usko bhi haye Nana teere sitam se maara, Asghar ki laash Sarwar laye magar chupake.
<<DIVIDER>>
Noke sina se cheeni zalim ne sar se chadar, Khoo'n hogaya tha jaari zakhmou se bhar gaya sar, Shamo damishqo kufa phirte the berida ke.
Nana teri nawasi darbar bhi gayi thi, Be jurm banke qaidi zindaan me rahi thi, Qaide sitam se aayi Nana saza batake.
'Abbas' dekh Zainab Yasrab se agayi hai, Qabre Rasool par ye nouha suna rahi hai, Usko padho bilawal tum ashke gham bahake...
